command:
set -euo pipefail
echo 'OMEGA_CHECKOUTS'
for d in "$HOME/oMEGA" "$HOME/omega" "$HOME/.local/share/oMEGA" "$HOME/.local/lib/oMEGA"; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then echo DIR=$d; git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD; git -C "$d" status --short --branch; [ -f "$d/omega/triggers.py" ] && sha256sum "$d/omega/triggers.py" || true; fi; done
echo 'PYTHON_IMPORT'
python3 - <<'PY'
try:
 import omega, omega.triggers
 print('omega='+str(getattr(omega,'__file__',None)))
 print('triggers='+str(getattr(omega.triggers,'__file__',None)))
 print('777='+repr(omega.triggers.resolve_trigger('777 MAXIMAL EFFEKTIV DURCHLAUFEN')))
except Exception as e:
 print('IMPORT_FAIL='+type(e).__name__+':'+str(e))
PY
echo 'SERVICE_EXECSTART'
for u in omega-chatgpt-mcp.service omega-local-effect-adapter.service; do echo UNIT=$u; systemctl --user show "$u" -p FragmentPath -p ExecStart -p MainPID -p ActiveState --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true; done
